instruction: Stand the red pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
# Grasp the pen lying on the table
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
# Look for a candidate aligned along the pen's long axis or choose best candidate
chosen = None
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True):
        chosen = c
        break
if not chosen and candidates:
    chosen = candidates[0]

# Set grasp height safely above 0.004m limit
if chosen:
    chosen["height"] = max(0.005, chosen.get("height", 0.006))
    res = grasp(chosen)

# If holding, insert upright into magenta_holder
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
table_z = obs["table_z"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# Move above the holder well above the rim
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.15)

# Tilt/orient gripper vertically to insert pen upright
# By default top-down grasp holds pen horizontally (along side vector)
# Pitching gripper by 90 degrees puts the pen vertical
# Alternatively, lower pen partially into holder and release so it stands inside
# Using move_gripper to orient gripper to place it vertically, or pitch finger_axis
# A simpler reliable insertion: approach from above, lower into the cup opening
move_gripper(hx, hy, table_z + rim_h + 0.04, approach=[0, 0, -1])
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("red_pen", "magenta_holder")

# Grasp the pen lying on or in the scene
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
chosen = None
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True):
        chosen = c
        break
if not chosen and candidates:
    chosen = candidates[0]

res = grasp(chosen)

# Target holder position and dimensions
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
table_z = obs["table_z"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.092)

# Lift well above holder
carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.20)

# The pen lies along the 'side' vector (side = approach x finger_axis).
# To make the pen vertical (pointing down into holder), we need 'side' to point along [0, 0, -1] or [0, 0, 1].
# When approach = [1, 0, 0] (horizontal forward) and finger_axis = [0, 1, 0], side = [0, 0, 1], so pen is vertical.
# Check reachable orientation with solve_ik:
approach_vec = [1, 0, 0]
finger_vec = [0, 1, 0]
ik = solve_ik(hx, hy, table_z + rim_h + 0.10, approach=approach_vec, finger_axis=finger_vec)
if not ik.get("reachable", False):
    approach_vec = [-1, 0, 0]
    finger_vec = [0, -1, 0]

# Rotate gripper so the pen becomes vertical
move_gripper(hx, hy, table_z + rim_h + 0.12, approach=approach_vec, finger_axis=finger_vec)

# Lower into the holder
move_by(dz=-0.06)
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("red_pen", "magenta_holder")
